name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A set of instructions that trains AI coding assistants to write the smallest, simplest fix instead of bloated code, the way an experienced developer avoids unnecessary work.
buyer: A developer or small team already using AI coding assistants who is frustrated by agents over-engineering simple fixes and wants tighter, more maintainable output.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it across client projects so AI-generated pull requests are smaller and easier for clients to review and approve.
A coding bootcamp uses it to teach students what 'good' minimal code looks like by comparing agent output with and without it.
A dev tooling startup bundles it as a default 'code quality' preset in their AI coding product to differentiate from competitors that produce bloated output.

money_ideas.idea: Bundle it into a paid 'AI code quality pack' of prompts and hooks sold to teams standardizing their AI coding workflow.
Offer it as a premium preset inside a hosted AI coding platform, charged as part of a higher subscription tier.

steal_this: This weekend, package it with a handful of other 'personality' presets (thorough tester, security-paranoid reviewer, docs-writer) and sell a small preset pack to developers who want to switch their agent's style per task.
